data.current_description: Creates an image or video capture. By default, the response redirects to the generated file. Set `output=json` to receive the request ID and file URL as JSON. Signed API keys also require `signature` and a non-zero `cache_ttl`.
data.summary_suggestion: Capture screenshot or video from URL
data.description_suggestion: Captures a screenshot or short video from a specified URL. By default, the response redirects directly to the generated media file. Set `output=json` to receive a JSON response containing the request ID and file URL instead. For signed API keys, you must provide a `signature` parameter and set `cache_ttl` to a non-zero value. Returns either a redirect to the media file or a JSON object with capture metadata and file location.
